profile.name: Siddharth Singh Bhadauria
profile.title: Senior Cloud / Data / AI Engineer
profile.bio: Senior Cloud, Data, and AI Engineer with 9.5+ years of experience building enterprise-scale GenAI platforms, cloud data pipelines, and infrastructure automation across GCP, AWS, and Azure. Specialized in LLM evaluation, RAG vector architectures, dbt analytics, and self-hosted homelab telemetry.

featured_projects.title: Cloud-FinOps-RAG
featured_projects.tagline: Autonomous Multi-Cloud AI Tokenomics & Price Benchmark Evaluator
featured_projects.description: Serverless data engineering pipeline built on GitHub Actions. Dynamically ingests tokenomics across Google Gemini 3.6, Anthropic Claude 3.7, OpenAI GPT-4.5/o3-mini, and DeepSeek, validates schemas via Great Expectations, computes cost-per-intelligence ratios in DuckDB, and generates daily RAG executive summaries.

featured_projects.title: Auto-DataPulse
featured_projects.tagline: UGREEN NAS Infrastructure Telemetry & Lakehouse Engine
featured_projects.description: Containerized homelab Lakehouse optimized for UGREEN NAS (32 GB RAM, Portainer). Ingests system metrics, executes Great Expectations contract gates, models gold analytics via dbt-core + DuckDB, and automatically publishes daily infrastructure health logs to GitHub.

featured_projects.title: Awesome-AI-Discoveries
featured_projects.tagline: Automated AI GitHub Repository Aggregator & Web Directory
featured_projects.description: Autonomous GitHub Actions bot that continuously discovers, sanitizes, categorizes, and logs trending open-source AI, RAG, and MCP repositories. Includes a dark glassmorphism Web Directory with theme switcher and quick view modal.

experience.role: Senior Developer – GenAI PairD & LLM Evaluation
highlights: Architected and developed Deloitte's enterprise PairD GenAI platform serving 75,000+ employees with OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, and Qdrant vector search.
Created an LLM evaluation framework using Confident AI DeepEval across MMLU, Answer Relevancy, and Contextual Accuracy for Mistral 7B, Llama 3, and Gemini on GCP Vertex AI.
Built DataSAFE encryption pipeline for PII masking using GPG, Python Cryptography, Azure Blob Storage, and Azure Functions.

experience.role: Azure Data Engineer – Credit Suisse Migration
highlights: Led migration pipelines for Credit Suisse to UBS data integration using Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Functions, and PostgreSQL/Sybase/Oracle databases.
Orchestrated cloud infrastructure using Terraform scripts and GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

experience.role: Senior Cloud Data Engineer & Scrum Master
highlights: Led POC for migrating CESOP financial payment application from AWS to GCP using DataProc, Cloud Functions, and Terraform.
Built near-real-time data ingestion pipelines connecting Apache Kafka, IBM CDC, AWS Kinesis, and Google Cloud Pub/Sub to BigQuery.
Built GCP ingestion pipeline for hyper-sensitive HR data across Workday, SuccessFactors, and BigQuery with GPG encryption and dbt transformations.
